original_test_intent: Benchmark every approved 1.92TB E1.S device with the four specified sequential/random read/write profiles and compare repeatable per-drive results to customer performance requirements without risking protected data.
original_method: Unresolved. Safe execution requires serial/WWN/controller/namespace/BDF/slot-bound disposable targets, boot/data exclusion, backup/empty proof, pinned fio, exact runtime/preconditioning/repeats/size/alignment, per-profile IOPS/BW/latency statistics and model-specific customer limits, endurance/thermal/SMART stops, integrity and cleanup. Raw `/dev/sdx` writes are prohibited meanwhile.
manual_activity: Storage owner designates disposable 1.92TB targets, approves destructive writes/endurance and supplies customer SPEC/recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: fio version check is safe discovery only; it cannot satisfy performance coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until the target-specific bounded job and customer SPEC are approved; then render explicit serial-verified jobs rather than substituting /dev names.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All four rw/block-size/ioengine/depth/jobs options and all-device 1.92TB scope retained as pending requirements.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one approved disposable namespace at a time, precondition consistently, run repeated bounded jobs and report per-drive distributions plus health/endurance deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves placeholder targeting, time/spec omissions and adds integrity/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A version check or read-only inventory is not a benchmark; a representative drive cannot replace all-device coverage without approval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sequential/random writes destroy data and consume endurance; cache/preconditioning/thermal state can dominate results.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines whether raw namespaces or scratch filesystems are required, all-device versus sampled scope, SPEC source and statistic, and allowed health/endurance change.
expected_evidence: Four raw JSON result sets per drive

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek only narrows to safe discovery and generic warning; it does not contradict the source, though it leaves benchmark coverage undone.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Direct write target is a placeholder and runtime/customer SPEC/data controls are absent, so execution cannot be safely or meaningfully judged.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row446 Wistron-Storage-00070-V004: provide every 1.92TB E1.S serial/WWN/model/namespace/BDF/slot disposable target with nonboot/backup proof, fio version, runtime/preconditioning/repeats/size/alignment, four-profile per-drive IOPS/BW/latency SPEC/tolerance, destructive-write/endurance/thermal/SMART limits, integrity, cleanup and recovery.

review_improvement: Blocks raw placeholder writes while preserving every source workload dimension for a target-specific safe benchmark.
independent_technical_reasoning: `/dev/sdx` cannot identify an NVMe E1.S device and may resolve to protected storage. Without runtime and numerical SPEC, even valid output has no verdict; without consistent preconditioning, cross-drive comparisons are not reproducible.
